prior_importants.description: Step 2 tells the reader to run `pup plan` to get the task's goal and scope-in, but `pup plan` only lists unclaimed backlog tasks, so a session that reads `awaiting-review` never appears in it.

findings.description: The skill says the conductor can run it, but its steps spawn project agents (review-conventions, review-spec, security-reviewer) and diff by `-C .worktrees/<task>` and a branch name. ADR 0118 says a conductor cannot load project agents and must not use either form for its review.
findings.body:
The skill says it runs "whether you are the console or the conductor" (line 9; the table at line 14 repeats it). But its steps only work for the console:

- **Step 4 (lines 51-54)** spawns the project agents `review-conventions`, `review-spec` and `security-reviewer`, with no fallback. [ADR 0118](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/591cb482a0738862d4df22970df8576f8a6a4b0b/docs/adr/0118-the-conductor-s-security-review-runs-a-general-purpose.md) (Status: accepted; amended by 0205 only for git pins) says at lines 21-28: "Every pup window, the conductor's included, launches `claude` with `--setting-sources user` … A kickoff that names a project agent therefore spawns nothing, in any repo." The code backs this up: `src/claude/session-runtime.service.ts:637-638` sets `--setting-sources user` for every window, and `skills/pup/LOOP.md:162-163` agrees. The ADR's answer is a general-purpose subagent (lines 13-14).
- **Step 1 (line 24)** diffs with `git -C .worktrees/<task> diff main...HEAD`. ADR 0118 lines 48-51 and 63-67 reject both bare branch names ("resolve to a planted tag or a moved HEAD") and `-C .worktrees/<id>` ("a session can point at a decoy repo … the review prints an empty diff that reads as clean").

So a conductor that follows the skill gets Agent calls that spawn nothing, and its diff can read a decoy repo and come back empty. ADRs win over other docs (AGENTS.md §Design docs).

To fix it, either limit the skill to the console, where project agents load, and send a conductor to its kickoff's pinned review. Or add a conductor path: general-purpose subagents with the same briefs, and diffs on resolved commit ids instead of `-C .worktrees` and branch names.

https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/591cb482a0738862d4df22970df8576f8a6a4b0b/.claude/skills/review-session/SKILL.md#L9-L24

findings.description: "add the `security-reviewer` agent as a third subagent, as LOOP.md §2 asks" gets LOOP.md wrong: skills/pup/LOOP.md:11-12 asks only for "a security-minded subagent" and never names the `security-reviewer` agent.

process_issues.description: The PR head moved during the review, from f5ee3dbd (the checkout) to 591cb482. The reviewers read f5ee3dbd. I re-checked both findings against `gh pr diff 439` at 591cb482: the flagged lines are unchanged, and the anchors and permalinks use the new head. The new head rewrote line 27, which resolves the prior important about `pup plan`.

Skipped correctness, security, context, simplicity, guards, workflow-safety and maintainability: the change is one docs-only skill file with no code logic, no workflow change and no new source. Skipped spec: there is no closing issue and no --spec.
